GPT-6 also reports that some parsed 028 clauses mix a heading fragment with sentence text; no aliases were named, so none are listed above. To be identified before any span-level benchmark.

consequence: Occurrence-level F1 and heading-level recall are different scopes: even a perfect F1 on parser occurrences cannot recover headings the parser never emits or emits only inside corrupted atoms. The held-out report must state the missing headings and the coverage losses.
